units: TTFT starts at the client and ends at the first nonempty content delta. Weighted output tok/s = sum of reported completion tokens / sum of concurrent wave durations. All per-wave durations include queue and prompt work. Per-stream decode uses (output tokens - 1)/(last output - first output).
raw_source: ab-raw.tar.gz contains original benchmark files and frozen fixtures. All paths and line numbers refer to this archive.
